summary: Frontend-only regression + new features test on Talent Vortex admin dashboard after refactor extracting Candidates/Messages/Interviews into /pages/admin/*.jsx. Admin login (captcha) succeeded. All 3 extracted pages render with expected data-testids and no console errors. New Messages features (conversation search + multi-select archive/delete toolbar) work correctly.

issues: Language shows EN labels ('Select a conversation', 'Users & roles', 'Schedule', 'Week/List') despite app description saying FRENCH — likely a locale toggle in header (FR/EN) defaulting to EN for this session, not a real bug.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminMessages.jsx polls GET /chat/conversations every 5s and GET /chat/messages every 2s while the tab is open — consider pausing when tab is hidden (document.visibilityState) to reduce load.
bulkDelete/bulkArchive fire Promise.all with .catch(() => {}) — individual failures are silently swallowed; toast always reports success count even if some failed. Consider surfacing per-id failures.
The search filter is client-side only (over already-loaded convs); fine for small lists but should be noted if conv count grows.
seed_data_creation: None — existing 3 conversations used (Dev Test, Saifullah Abdallah, Alex Salvador). Archived Alex Salvador during test then reactivated to restore state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor of AdminDashboard into 3 sub-pages is stable. Login flow: click 'Sign in' text link → fill email/password → solve captcha (last input on form, math shown as 'a + b') → submit. When testing multi-select archive: after clicking bulk-archive-btn, allow 3s+ then reload conversations (loadConvs polls every 5s). UI defaults to EN — click FR toggle in top-right if French labels are needed.
verified_flows: nav-candidates → candidate-search + rating-filter + nationality panel + user rows present
nav-interviews → agenda-view-week/list toggles + interview-search-input + new-interview-btn dialog opens
nav-messages → 3 conversations render, no console errors
conv-search-input filters shownConvs; clearing restores full list
clicking a conv row while in select mode toggles conv-check-<id> instead of opening chat
bulk-archive-btn calls PUT /chat/conversations/{id}/active {active:false} — toast '1 conversation(s) archivée(s)' shown, target confirmed inactive via toggle-conv-active label='Activer'
single conv-delete-<id> button present in DOM (hover-revealed)
Panel uses h-[calc(100vh-11rem)] wrapper; conversation list scrolls internally
